name: On Hit
description: Fires when any of your effects damages an enemy. x0.35 output. Fires about 190 times a second in a busy run.

name: On Kill
description: Fires when an enemy dies to your effects. x1.6 output.

name: On Pickup
description: Fires when you collect an XP shard. x4 output. A Magnet sweep fires it once per shard.

name: On Crit
description: Fires when one of your hits crits. x3 output. Base crit chance is 10%.

name: On Dash
description: Fires when you dash. x20 output.

name: On Wound
description: Fires when you take damage. x40 output.

name: On Wave
description: Fires when a new wave composition arrives, roughly every 40s. x50 output.

name: On Overheat
description: Fires when Heat reaches 100. x60 output.

name: On Convert
description: Fires when a Convert action resolves. x6 output.

name: On Idle
description: Fires when THIS row has not fired for 2s. x30 output. A metronome that only runs when the rest of the row is idle.

name: On Threshold
description: Fires when Heat crosses into a higher Instability tier: 40, 70 or 100. x25 output.

name: On Depth
description: Fires when one of your cascades reaches depth 5. x14 output. Once per row per tick.

name: On Sweep
description: Fires when you collect a Magnet. x45 output.

name: On Glutton
description: Fires when any enemy detonates: a gorged Interceptor, a Volatile elite, or a Charged variant. x18 output.

name: On Enter
description: Fires when you enter a hazard: a suppression field or a Containment boundary. x22 output.
